HUMAN_COVERAGE_AUTHORITY.scope: Admit only the measured twelve-country TED coverage with explicit TED-only limitations; do not imply worldwide procurement coverage.

LEGAL.scope: Admit TED under the reviewed EU reuse framework, attribution and change-disclosure conditions, with all third-party and protected-content exclusions.

PRIVACY_DATA_RIGHTS.scope: Admit only the approved non-personal TED field set; keep contact values ephemeral and excluded from persistence, search and marketing.

PRODUCT.scope: Admit TED Search API v3 as a bounded product source for AX-LIB-O01; authorize only the measured TED scope and no public launch.

SECURITY.scope: Admit the bounded TED connector under the verified CMS retention, kill-switch, rollback, network and no-secret controls.

SOURCE_QUALITY.scope: Admit TED based on the frozen 180-notice sample, twelve observed countries, six-language journeys and unchanged quality and lag thresholds.

UX_ACCESSIBILITY.scope: Admit the six verified multilingual TED journeys for bounded product presentation with source traceability and no raw-text republication.
